title: Production of polyclonal antibodies against protein antigens purified by electroelution from SDS-polyacrylamide gel
protocol: Transform protease-deficient _E. coli_ strain with a plasmid expression vector carrying cDNA or cDNA fragment of interest.
Spread transformation on appropriate LB medium plate and incubate overnight at 37°C.
Inoculate 5 ml of LB medium with a single colony of _E. coli_ cells and incubate overnight at 37°C with shaking.
Inoculate 50 ml of LB medium in 250 ml E-flask with 500 μl of culture (dilution 1:100) and grow at 37°C with shaking until the absorbance at 600 nm reaches 0.5-0.7.
Add the suitable inducer for the expression of the protein of interest according to the plasmid vector used, e.g., 0.5 mM (final concentration) IPTG and incubate for an additional 2 h.
Centrifuge the cell culture at 7,700g for 10 min at 4°C, discard the supernatant, and wash the pellet with 1X Phosphate-Buffered Saline (PBS).
Suspend the cell pellet by adding 50 μl of 1X PBS per ml of culture.
Sonicate on ice in short bursts to disrupt the cells until a partial clearing of the suspension is observed.
Add an appropriate aliquot of SDS-PAGE Loading Buffer to the cell homogenate and load 100-150 μl per well on a large (e.g., 18 X 20 cm) SDS-polyacrylamide gel.
Run gel according to standard methods until maximum separation of the protein of interest is obtained.
Cut two vertical strips on the sides of the gel.
Stain the cut strips in 0.3% Coomassie Blue/10% acetic acid for 5 minutes.
Discolour the stained strips in a 30% ethanol/10% acetic acid solution.
Realign the discoloured strips to the gel sides.
Cut a long horizontal strip at the level of the band of interest.
Cut the long strip into 1-cm pieces.
Place the gel pieces vertically into the mini elution chamber of the S&S BIOTRAP device.
Perform electroelution at 200 V for 4 hours using 15 mM ammonium bicarbonate as the elution buffer.
Remove eluate from the trap chamber using a Pasteur pipette after completion.
Store the eluted product at -80°C until use.
Load an aliquot of the eluted product on a mini SDS-polyacrylamide gel along with bovine serum albumin (BSA) of known concentration to evaluate quantity and purity.
Concentrate purified proteins using suitable centrifugal filters if necessary.
Lyophilize concentrated proteins and store them at -80°C.
